hypothesis: At least one mature source-only nearest-case descriptor can recover a material fraction of the BQ1v2 evaluator-Oracle gap across whole-camera development folds and then improve both frozen confirmation target variants with hard Top-1 selection plus a source-distance global fallback.

descriptor.normalization: development-bank mean/std per held whole-camera fold

selector.policy: hard Top-1 Euclidean nearest case or pooled-global fallback
selector.threshold_fit: source-only cross-camera nearest-neighbour distance within each development bank

development_evaluation.method: leave-one-camera-model-out; cases and pooled global exclude the held camera

confirmation_evaluation.family_selection: highest mean development improvement among families passing both target variants; config-order tie break

branch_rules.development_no_family_passes: close BQ2A without confirmation execution and open only a preregistered pairwise source-compatibility learner
branch_rules.confirmation_fails: close these nearest-neighbour families without descriptor/threshold rescue; pairwise learning may use development targets only under a new contract
branch_rules.confirmation_passes: freeze hard retrieval before considering sparse Top-K or a learned pairwise challenger
branch_rules.severe_tail_or_concentration_fails: close without dense blending or target-aware fallback

claim_ceiling: source-only hard case retrieval on paired FiveK digital-retouch controls; not film response, stock identity, calibration, preference or product evidence
